Yes, you can change the shipping address within 2 hours of purchase by accessing your order through your Account page.
Important limitations:
Address changes are only possible within the same state due to sales tax variations — requests to change to a different state will be denied.
If you notice an error before the order ships, contact Support immediately to request an update.
